status: Source-checked editorial verse-division mappings; not word-level alignment or a claim of textual equality

mappings.note: UGNT 13:12 includes both the holy-kiss greeting and all-saints greeting, divided between KJV 13:12 and 13:13.
KJV 13:13 is the all-saints greeting in the latter part of UGNT 13:12.
The closing grace, love and communion benediction is numbered UGNT 13:13 and KJV 13:14; wording and closing material differ by edition.
KJV 1:14 combines the face-to-face expectation and closing greetings, divided into UGNT 1:14 and 1:15.
The standing-on-the-shore clause is UGNT 12:18; the beast vision is UGNT 13:1. KJV 13:1 includes both. The standing clause also has a textual difference in its subject.
